    @classmethod
    def from_json(cls, text: str) -> "Version":
        """
        Create a Version object from a JSON object string.

        The JSON object must contain the keys ``major``, ``minor``, and
        ``patch``; ``prerelease`` and ``build`` are optional. This accepts
        exactly the inputs :func:`semver.loads_version` accepts and raises
        the same errors.

        :param text: the JSON text of one object
        :return: a new :class:`Version` instance
        :raises ValueError: if the text is not a valid version object

        >>> semver.Version.from_json('{"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":3}')
        Version(major=1, minor=2, patch=3, prerelease=None, build=None)
        """
        from .jsonio import loads_version

        return loads_version(text)
